title: 2025’s Darkest Anime Returns With New Movie This Fall – Watch the Trailer
content:
One of the darkest anime of the last year is coming back with a new feature film release later this Fall, and a new trailer is showing more of it off before it hits theaters across Japan. Crunchyroll has been home to some truly dark anime releases that have caught fans off guard in a few ways, and there’s probably no better example of this than with the anime adaptation for Taizan 5’s Takopi’s Original Sin . Now it’s coming back to break hearts all over again, but just on the big screen this time.

Takopi’s Original Sin The Movie: Thank You, See You Tomorrow is a new compilation film that repackages the six episode miniseries into a new feature film package with new materials teased for the upgrade. This new version of the anime is gearing up for its debut across theaters in Japan later this Fall, and a new trailer is helping to show off the best look at the anime yet. You can check it out along with a new poster you can find below.

Takopi’s Original Sin Movie Reveals New Trailer Ahead of Japan Launch

Takopi’s Original Sin The Movie: Thank You, See You Tomorrow is currently scheduled to hit theaters in Japan on November 27th , but no potential international release plans have been announced as of this time. The new film version features a returning staff from the TV anime series with Shinya Iino directing and handling the scripts for ENISHIYA, and Keita Nagahara providing the character designs. The main voice cast for the anime include Kurumi Mamiya as Takopi, Reina Ueda as Shizuka Kuze, Konomi Kohara as Marina, and Anna Nagase as Azuma.

Takopi’s Original Sin The Movie: Thank You, See You Tomorrow is a new compilation film retooling the events of the six episode miniseries adapting Taizan 5’s original manga. This new film is teased to be the most complete version of the story with new footage exclusive to the film version , and a new theme song for the overall package titled “Love You” as performed by Tele. But as for what new footage might be included in the experience, it’s still being kept a mystery as of this time.

What Is Takopi’s Original Sin & Why Is It So Dark?

Takopi’s Original Sin made its debut last Summer with a much different kind of anime experience than fans had ever expected when it was first made available for streaming with Crunchyroll . Not only did it have a much shorter run of episodes overall than every other anime seen last year, but its content was some of the darkest seen that year too. Dealing with some very real topics like child abuse, neglect, murder, suicide and more, it was all the more heartbreaking due to the very young characters at the center of these developments.

Takopi’s Original Sin might not have had as explosive of an anime debut as some of the other new anime releases fans had seen last year , but it had made a strong impact thanks to the number of intense sequences and moments throughout its run. It was one surprise after another, and this film version is likely going to take it all to the next level. Would you want to see the new Takopi’s Original Sin movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Simpsons Goes Full Nightmare Before Christmas for New Treehouse of Horror Special – Watch
content:
The Simpsons is on the cusp of a brand new entry in its annual Treehouse of Horror anthology series this weekend, and to celebrate has dropped the first look at its new makeover inspired by The Nightmare Before Christmas for the occasion. The Simpsons has already surprised fans this year with the debut of a second Treehouse of Horror special episode this season, and took that even further with Apu’s official return with a new voice actor. But there’s still the actual anthology special to look forward to next.

The Simpsons “Treehouse of Horror XXXVII” is coming with the next episode of Season 38, and will have a new intro sequence inspired by The Nightmare Before Christmas animated by the team at Stoopid Buddy, the same studio behind hits like Robot Chicken . It’s a spooky way to kick off the new special, and you can check it out before the new Halloween episode airs this Sunday in the video below.

The Simpsons Treehouse of Horror XXXVII Reveals Nightmare Before Christmas Opening

The Simpsons “Treehouse of Horror XXXVII” serves as the second Treehouse of Horror special episode we’ll see in Season 38 , and is scheduled to premiere with Fox on Sunday, October 25th at 8:00PM ET. Much like all of the other Halloween anthology episodes seen in the past, this year will feature three new stories not tied to the events of the main series. The first will be parody of Holly Gramazio’s novel The Husbands that sees Marge dealing with one new husband after another. The second sees a blend of two popular stories with Pet Sematary as the focus.

Homer accidentally kills both Bart and Santa’s Little Helper, and the two end up swapping bodies when buried together. The third is the most mysterious of the stories, however, is one where Homer is trapped in those Driver’s Education videos with terrible car crashes. Much like every other year before it, no character is safe and there will likely be lots of brutal deaths to showcase through the course of each segment before it’s all said and done for spooky season this year.

Why The Simpsons Treehouse of Horror Episodes Are Special

The Simpsons ‘ Treehouse of Horror episodes have been a fun tradition for the animated series going all the way back to its second season, and each year has provided fans with memorable Horror stories . There have been so many attempts that there are bound to be a few of them that are more revered than the others, but each one is fun nonetheless. Because they operate outside of the main canon for the franchise, they’re allowed to make all kinds of choices that couldn’t be seen with other episodes.

The Simpsons has begun to expand its Treehouse of Horror offerings with other Treehouse of Horror Presents specials in the later seasons that extend their runtimes to an entire episode, and that’s led to some great reveals like with Apu’s return to the franchise. But with this annual anthology coming our way, it’s time to see what new treats it has to offer. What are you hoping to see in the new Treehouse of Horror special? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Korra Officially Recast With Avatar: Seven Havens Return (New Voice Actor Confirmed)
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has officially reintroduced Korra to the animated series with its newest batch of episodes of Paramount+, and with it has confirmed that a new voice actor has taken over for the role. Avatar: Seven Havens has been in the midst of a new era for the long running animated franchise as Avatar Studios has introduced fans to two new Avatars taking over after Korra. But unfortunately, it’s been teased that Korra has been the case of a great cataclysm that destroyed the world years before.

Avatar: Seven Havens returned to Paramount+ this past weekend with Episodes 7-9, and with it has officially addressed Korra’s time as the Avatar for the first real time on screen. While she had been teased to have destroyed the world , a new flashback reveals that this might have truly been the case. To go along with this new look at Korra, it’s also been revealed by Cia Court (Vi in League of Legends , Ruri in Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles ) has taken over the role as confirmed on the star’s social media, “I guess the cat monkey’s out of the bag! Yes, you heard me as Korra in Avatar Seven Havens ! But is she really as bad as people think she is?”

Korra Reveals New Voice Actor With Avatar: Seven Havens Return

Avatar: Seven Havens is set hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra , so it was definitely a mystery to see how the franchise would be able to see Korra return to action with the sequel series. Avatar: Seven Havens Episode 7 “What Lies Beneath,” sees Pavi and Nisha finding underground ruins with old technology revealing things had looked like during Korra’s time, but after the events of The Legend of Korra . But then a flashback further reveals to the two of them when they tap into the underlying connection between the Avatars.

This flashback reveals to the two of them that Korra had indeed caused the cataclysm thanks to something that seemingly had gone wrong, but there’s no explanation as to why just yet. Though Korra herself doesn’t really speak in the episode, her few grunts and motions are the first from Court’s time with the role. Following Janet Varney stepping away from the role in 2022 (though still remaining very active within the Avatar franchise such as working on the Avatar: Braving the Elements podcast), Court is a sign we’ll see much more of Korra going forward.

What Does This Mean for Korra in Avatar: Seven Havens ?

Avatar: Seven Havens has been setting up the fact that Korra destroyed the world during her time as Avatar, and years later the world is still trying to recover from the cataclysm. This latest flashback seemingly sees her enact cede catalcysm, but there’s just not enough to go on yet to fully place the blame on her. With how much has been teased within the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise on a whole, there’s likely going to be a reasonable explanation behind it.

It’s further emphasizing all of the real world criticism and hate that Korra as a character received during The Legend of Korra ‘s run , so it seems like the team at Avatar: Seven Havens is going to use it as a way to build out Pavi and Nisha’s own journey. But what do you think of Korra’s return in Avatar: Seven Havens so far? What are you hoping to see from the former Avatar next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 First Look Confirms More Returning Character Makeovers
content:
Delicious in Dungeon is now in the works on Season 2 of the anime , and the anime has dropped the first look at more of the returning characters fans will see in action with the new episodes. The first season taking on Ryuko Kui’s original manga was such a massive hit, but it’s been three years since fans have gotten to see any of the anime in action. The long wait will be over soon enough as we’re starting to see more and more of the new season now in development.

Delicious in Dungeon is currently slated for a release next Fall, and while it’s still a year out before its release, thankfully the anime has dropped a fresh update as it all comes together. Following the first look revealed earlier this year of the main returning party , Delicious in Dungeon has revealed more of the returning faces and character designs that fans will see in Season 2. As detailed through the anime’s official social media , you can check out the new Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 character designs below.

Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 Confirms Returning Characters With First Look

Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 has now confirmed more returning members of the voice cast with Saori Hayami as Falin, Wataru Kato as Kabru, Koki Uchiyama as Mithrun, and Yu Kobayashi as Thistle. Not only does this reveal their looks for the new season, but also further emphasizes how the anime team has further tweaked the character designs to be more in line with Ryoko Kui’s original manga art . With these characters being revealed little by little, there’s a chance we’ll see it in motion soon enough as we get closer to its launch.

Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 is now in the works for a release with Netflix sometime in October 2027 ( which is going to be a big month for Fantasy anime fans ), but has yet to reveal a more concrete release date as of this time. That gives you plenty of time to catch up with everything that’s happened in the first season with Netflix, and you’ll want to do so as the 24 episodes of its run ended up bringing the adaptation of Kui’s original manga run to its halfway point. Which likely means that this second wave of episodes is going to be last if it adapts it all to the end,

What to Know for Delicious in Dungeon Season 2

Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 will feature a returning production staff from the first season with Yoshihiro Miyajima directing for Studio Trigger, Kimiko Ueno serving as story editor, Yasunori Mitsuda composing the music, and Naoki Takeda providing the character designs. It was also previously confirmed that Kentaro Kumagai will be returning as Laios, Sayaka Sembongi as Marcille, Asuna Tomari as Chilchuck, Hiroshi Naka as Senshi, and Mitsuho Kambe as Izutsumi. So the returning cast is steadily coming together.

Delicious in Dungeon was a breakout success when it first made its debut with Netflix, and the first season ended with quite a tease for the future. Laios and his party discovered that the only way to truly save Falin was to fully devour every piece of dragon, it’s set them out on a whole new path. Are you excited for Delicious in Dungeon ‘s Season 2 comeback? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dragon Ball Hypes Jump Festa With Cool New Look
content:
2026 is one of the most exciting years for Dragon Ball fans, as the year kicked off with several exciting announcements. Dragon Ball originally concluded its manga serialization in 1995, which is why its return two decades later was the most exciting surprise for fans. Thanks to the franchise’s global impact, it maintains a huge fan base even three decades after the main story’s ending. The anime also returned with its latest remake this Fall 2026 season. Additionally, the anime will continue later on with the Galactic Patrol Saga of Dragon Ball Super .

The anime is returning after more than eight years , and it’s going to be more epic than ever. However, before the anime continues the main story with a new adventure after the Tournament of Power Saga, Toei Animation released a remake titled Dragon Ball Super: Beerus . The franchise is planning for more surprises before the end of the year, especially during Jump Festa, which will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026. The official X handle of AMNIBUS drops a gorgeous new visual featuring Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, and Gotenks. The visual depicts their forms and outfits, particularly from the final saga of the main story.

Dragon Ball Won’t Be in the Spotlight During Jump Festa 2027

The new visual shared by AMNIBUS was particularly for merchandise and not the anime’s future. It was revealed along with several other series such as Jujutsu Kaisen , Spy x Family , and more. Additionally, the caption confirms that the visual follows a concept of a journey featuring some of the most crucial characters in the story. The post also confirms that AMNIBUS will share more updates, probably before the Jump Festa begins. However, while this is surely an exciting update for fans who will be visiting the venue, the anime won’t be taking a stage this year.

In September, the official website of Jump Festa already revealed the titles of all the manga and anime series holding a panel to announce their future projects. Despite being one of the biggest franchises in history, Dragon Ball was not listed among those series, not even in the Super Stage, which is the biggest stage at Jump Festa. While the series already has major plans in the future, it seems fans might have to wait longer than expected to get updates on them.

Dragon Ball Super ‘s New Anime Will Adapt One of the Best Arcs of All Time

While the anime is currently airing the remake of the initial arcs, Toei will also adapt the Galactic Patrol Saga for the first time. The anime adaptation of Dragon Ball Super debuted in 2015 as a long-running series and wrapped up the Tournament of Power Saga in 2018. Goku’s Ultra Instinct took the internet by storm , but unfortunately, the anime bid farewell to fans not long after the phenomenal episode. After making fans wait for eight years, the anime confirmed a sequel season of the series at the start of the year. The story will head towards a new direction after the intense Tournament of Power.

The animation studio hasn’t revealed a release window or a teaser yet, and it might take a while for it to be released. The biggest project from the animation studio for this year is the remake series, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , which will begin airing in October as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. The remake aims to release a more faithful adaptation of Toriyama’s story with more polished visuals and better pacing.

title: New The Apothecary Diaries Movie Trailer Shows Off Best Look Yet – Watch Now
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is coming to the big screen later this year, and a new trailer for its feature film debut is really showing off the best look yet at what fans can hope to see. The Apothecary Diaries is back in action for Season 3 of the TV anime series this Fall, and has really been taking over streaming platforms so far . But that’s far all that fans are going to see in the near future either as a new movie is going to tell an original story next.

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure is a brand new movie now in the works for the anime franchise, and is scheduled to make its way through theaters in Japan this December. This is going to come at the perfect time with a break in between new episodes of the third season, so fans are going to be treated with a whole new Jinshi and Maomao adventure to make the wait easier. You can check out the new trailer and poster for The Apothecary Diaries movie below.

When Does The Apothecary Diaries Movie Come Out?

title: Kaiju No. 8 Anime to End With Final Movie in 2027 – Watch First Look Teaser
content:
Kaiju No. 8 is gearing up for its grand finale, and the anime has dropped the first look teaser for its new movie coming to theaters across Japan next year. Naoya Matsumoto’s Kaiju No. 8 has been one of Shueisha’s biggest breakout successes of the last few years. Though the manga already ended with the Shonen Jump+ app , the anime has gone on to a ton of acclaim worldwide with just two seasons. Now there’s going to be one final project on the way to bring it all to an appropriately grand finale.

Following the end of the second season last year, Kaiju No. 8 confirmed that it would be returning for one final project for the anime’s final ar c. A new update from TOHO Animation has now revealed this final project to be a new feature film, and it’s scheduled to hit theaters in Japan next year. To celebrate the new reveal, you can check out the first teaser and poster for the new Kaiju No. 8 movie below.

Kaiju No. 8: The Final Mission to End the Anime in 2027

Kaiju No. 8: The Final Mission has been officially announced as a new feature film serving as the “Conclusion Arc” for the anime overall. Releasing in theaters across Japan sometime next year, no concrete release date or potential international release plans have yet to be announced as of this time. Director Shigeyuki Miya will be returning from the TV anime to oversee the new film for Production I.G. and TOHO Animation, and art director Shinji Kimura provided this first look at the project, but further staff details have not been confirmed either.

There are lots of questions raised about what to expect from Kaiju No. 8: The Final Mission just with this reveal too. Kaiju No. 8 Season 2 left things off in the midst of a huge wave of fights against Kaiju No. 9 , but there is actually still quite a lot of material from the manga release left to adapt for the anime. If the franchise is indeed going to end with this new feature film, it’s hard to imagine that it’s going to be able to get everything taken care of in such a short run time. This might be going the route of offering an original story instead.

What’s Next for Kaiju No. 8 ?

The first look at Kaiju No. 8: The Final Mission teases a deviation from the manga too because while the monster teased here does have some similarities with a familiar villain from Kaiju No. 8 ‘s final arc , it does look different enough to tease that the film could be going its own route for the anime’s finale. Either way, there’s still a lot to catch up with in the meantime if you wanted to check it out. You can find the first two seasons of Kaiju No. 8 now streaming with Crunchyroll, and a special miniseries about Narumi is on YouTube.

Kaiju No. 8 might have ended its manga run last year, but the franchise on a whole is picking up steam. This new feature film is already a step forward, but it’s also being rumored that a Hollywood live-action feature film is now in development as well . If both of these projects hit the big screen, it’ll be hard to deny this monster hit. What are you hoping to see in Kaiju No. 8′ s finale movie? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments!

title: Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Most Ambitious Seinen Anime Has Bad News for Season 3
content:
Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen are among the greatest anime out there, partly thanks to how they were brought to life by MAPPA . The studio took over production of Attack on Titan starting with its final season, and despite fans’ doubts, the anime emerged as one of the best. This established MAPPA’s reputation as one of the leading anime studios, further reinforced by its work on Vinland Saga , another one of the greatest seinen anime ever made. Like Attack on Titan , Vinland Saga also transitioned from WIT Studio to MAPPA starting with its second season.

With two seasons, Vinland Saga has proven itself to be in a league of its own, delivering a perfect revenge narrative that evolves into a somber reflection on the self and a redemption story that touches the heart. With the second season having ended more than three years ago and the manga having concluded more than a year ago , fans are anxious to learn when the third season will arrive. When one fan asked the creator of Vinland Saga , Makoto Yukimura, the same question on X, the author shared a disappointing update, revealing that there has still been no progress on the anime.

3 Years After Season 2, WIT and MAPPA Studios’ Critically Acclaimed Seinen Series Still Has No Updates

The creator of Vinland Saga has been one of the most active creators on X, sharing plenty of insights into his life and work, especially since the manga came to an end last year. He has been transparent about the anime’s development for some time, with Yukimura also debunking rumors about the third season being in development earlier this year. Now, in the latest update, a fan asked about the anime’s development, and Makoto replied that there was no good news, as there had been no progress on the anime whatsoever. Considering how creators are often heavily involved in their manga’s anime adaptations, Makoto’s response adds weight to the possibility that Vinland Saga Season 3 is not even in development yet .

Meanwhile, neither Kodansha nor MAPPA, the companies involved in the anime’s production, have shared even the slightest update on its development since Season 2. It is frustrating that a series like Vinland Saga has yet to receive further anime adaptations. One possible reason is that, since Season 2, the anime’s production has involved multiple companies, including Twin Engine, Kodansha, Production I.G., and MAPPA, as part of a joint production committee. The development cycles of such anime can often be lengthy, which could be a major reason why there is still no good news about the series’ future.

Even if the third season were announced and entered production, it would still take years before fans could watch it. Meanwhile, seeing the anime reach its conclusion would require even more time, potentially at least another five years, given the substantial amount of manga content left to adapt. The development of the Vinland Saga anime has unfortunately been very slow , and with the manga now finished, it is a shame that Season 3 remains unannounced. Perhaps the manga’s conclusion has helped the production committee plan the remaining story as a whole, potentially allowing the third season to adapt the rest of the narrative and serve as the anime’s final season.

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Cour 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer Ahead of January 2027 Debut
content:
Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court has released a teaser trailer for its second cour, which will begin airing in January 2027. The new episodes covering the The First Royal Outing arc were announced immediately after Cour 1 finished, and they are set to continue the story of Kou Reirin and Shu Keigetsu. Their relationship has now developed into a friendship, and the pair will be traveling to the southern territory governed by the Shu family.

The cast members joining Though I Am an Inept Villainess in Cour 2 are:

• Yuichi Nakamura as Kou Keikou, Reirin’s eldest brother

• Shunichi Toki as Kou Keishou, Reirin’s second-eldest brother

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Unran, who was described as ‘the young leader of a village in the southern territories who becomes an important figure as the story expands.‘

You can watch the new trailer below.

You can also watch an English sub version of the trailer:

Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court is a Japanese light novel series by Satsuki Nakamura. It was first published online on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in July 2020. Later that year, in December, Ichijinsha released the print edition featuring illustrations by YukiKana. Around the same time, a manga adaptation illustrated by Ei Ohitsuji began serialization in Monthly Comic Zero Sum. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both the light novel and manga in English, describing the story for the former: In the Kingdom of Ei, five clans put forth their maidens as imperial consorts—but only one will be crowned empress. Just when frail and beautiful “court butterfly” Kou Reirin seems poised to marry the crown prince, jealous “court rat” Shu Keigetsu steals her body! Reirin wakes up in the dungeons as the conspirator, and things look dire…or do they? Now that she’s got a robust new body, not even the looming threat of execution can stop her!

We recently had the chance to interview Hana Hishikawa , the voice of Leelee.

title: Kaiju No. 8 Final Movie Announced for 2027 as Anime Conclusion
content:
Kaiju No. 8: The Movie will officially conclude with the series as a theatrical film set for release in 2027, bringing the anime series to its final chapter on the big screen. The movie will follow the first two seasons of the TV anime and serve as the conclusion to the entire adaptation. It was originally announced during Jump Festa 2026 alongside the Narumi’s Week at Work 4-episode special.

A super teaser visual was revealed alongside the announcement featuring the tagline, “The age of humanity ends.” Studio Production I.G is returning to handle the animation production for the film.

Masaya Fukunishi, who voices Kafka Hibino, commented:

“After the broadcasts of Seasons 1 and 2, we’ve been able to enjoy the Kaiju No. 8 anime together with everyone. And now, in 2027, this series will finally reach its conclusion with a theatrical film! Next year will also be the year I turn 32, the same age as Kafka. I can’t help but feel that there’s something fateful about reaching the final chapter at this particular moment…! Until the very, very end, I’ll continue giving everything I have to creating this work that I love so much, together with my beloved Kafka Hibino and Kaiju No. 8. Thank you for all your support!!”

Studio Production I.G is animating again, with Studio Khara back in charge of the creature designs. The anime so far released a total of 23 episodes between April 13, 2024 and September 27, 2025.

The Kaiju No. 8 manga by Naoya Matsumoto began serialization in July 2020 on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ platform. The manga series officially ended in July with Chapter 129 and was compiled into a total of 16 volumes. Viz Media is publishing it in English, describing the story: Kafka hopes to one day keep his pact with his childhood friend Mina to join the Japan Defense Force and fight by her side. But while she’s out neutralizing kaiju as Third Division captain, Kafka is stuck cleaning up the aftermath of her battles. When a sudden rule change makes Kafka eligible for the Defense Force, he decides to try out for the squad once more. There’s just one problem—he’s made the Defense Force’s neutralization list under the code name Kaiju No. 8.

The game adaptation of the franchise, Kaiju No. 8 THE GAME , exceeded 750,000 million pre-registrations and launched worldwide on August 31, 2025.
